backup.restore_point: PENDING_FRESH_BACKUP: stamp with scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs right before the apply
backup.production_rule: Two follow-ups, no table, column, row or ACL change. (a) The four-argument staff_decline_direct_booking_v1 (cf_confirm_flow) also declines a booking the hold sweep marked expired when a reason_code event is already on file for it (booking_lifecycle_events.after_state has the key reason_code); a retry on such a row posts no second guest notice; every other status is refused exactly as before; same signature, security definer, empty search_path, grants restated (authenticated only). (b) inventory_purchases.purchased_at defaults to public.manila_today() instead of CURRENT_DATE (UTC); the receipt RPCs still pass coalesce(p_purchased_at, current_date) themselves and are NOT changed (their md5 is pinned by s132 to s134).
backup.notes: Apply after cf_confirm_flow (20261205000000) is applied (the guard raises 55000 otherwise). No begin/commit in the file: the runner wraps it with the ledger row. Restamp restore_point and verified_at with a fresh backup at apply time (scripts/migrations/fill-restore-point.mjs; the checker refuses one older than an hour) and source.commit to the reviewed head. No app push is needed: Staff 3.4.53 and later already call the decline.

The runner then ran the 6 forward checks a third time: 6 passed, 0 failed. pgTAP s136_followups 41 of 41; the seven baseline suites (admin_access_simplification, confirm_flow, inquiry_one_tap, s104_close_gaps, s110_kpi_supply_laundry, s134_expenses, s135_pay_extras_fix) fail exactly the numbers in accepted_failing_tests and none else (compared by number).
